tagline: A safer internet, behind a little gate
brief: An Android parental-control app with no accounts and no cloud. It filters a child's internet on the phone and keeps every exit behind a parent PIN. Parents install it and pay for it; children live inside it. It should feel calm and trustworthy to parents, and friendly to kids, without looking like surveillance.
criteria: Success: no shields, padlocks, eyes or family figures; reads at 16 px and as an Android adaptive icon; works in one colour; friendly enough for kids, credible to parents.
